in_arabic.name: عنيس
in_arabic.meaning: الرفيق الحبيب، الشخص الذي يأنس بوجوده
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أنيس مشتق من الجذر العربي (ن-ي-س) الذي يحمل معاني الرفاقة، الحب، والأنس. يدل على الشخص الذي يأنس بوجوده، ويكون رفيقًا محبوبًا. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان الآية 2: 'وَالَّذِينَ يَأْتُونَ بِالزِّنَا وَلَا يَأْتُونَ بِشَهَادَةٍ وَلَا يَكْذِبُونَ وَلَا يَأْتُونَ بِبَاطِعٍ وَأُوْلَـئِكَ الَّذِينَ يَأْتُونَ بِالْفَاحِشَةِ مَبْذُولَةً أُولَـئِكَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ وَحَسُنَ أُوْلَـئِكَ رَفِيقًا'

in_urdu.name: انیس
in_urdu.long_meaning: انیس نام کی عربی اصل (ن-ي-س) سے ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رفیق، دوست، اور محبوب۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ پیارے پن اور رفاقت کی علامت ہے۔ انیس ابن ابی طالب کا نام ہے جو حضرت علی (ع) کے بھائی اور رفیق تھے۔

in_hindi.name: अनीस
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनीस नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रिय मित्र या साथी। इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में है, क्योंकि यह प्यार और साथीपन का प्रतीक है। अनीस इब्न अबी तालिब का नाम है, जो हज़रत अली के भाई और साथी थे।

in_pashto.name: انیس
in_pashto.long_meaning: د انیس نوم عربي اصل (ن-ي-س) څخه دی چې د دوست، رفیق او ګران معنی لري. دا نوم د افغانستان په مسلم ټولنه کې د پام وړ دی، ځکه چې د مينې او رفاقت نښه ده.

in_english.name: Anis
in_english.long_meaning: The name Anis is derived from the Arabic root (ن-ي-س) which carries meanings of companionship, love, and intimacy. It signifies a close friend or a beloved person. In Islamic tradition, Anis is associated with positive qualities such as friendship and affection. The name has historical significance, being the name of Anis ibn Abi Talib, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad.

data.cultural_impact: The name Anis has a rich cultural significance in Islamic history and communities. It is a name often given to a child as a symbol of the prophetic companionship between the child and their parents. The name Anis also denotes the importance of companionship, love, and friendship in Islamic teachings. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) often emphasized the importance of such relationships, as seen in his famous Hadith, ''The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, and both continue in the same religion.'' (Muslim). The name Anis can be a reminder of the importance of these deep and enduring relationships and the role they play in our daily lives and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Anis is a name that represents the comforting presence of Allah (swt) in our lives. The name evokes the image of a close friend, a devoted and loyal companion, who is always there to offer support, guidance, and love. In Sufi spirituality, the belief is that every believer has a personal guide, a 'murshid' or spiritual guide, who helps them on their journey towards Allah. The name Anis can be seen as a reminder of this relationship, as the word 'anis' can also mean 'solace' or 'consolation'. In times of hardship or difficulty, Anis can serve as a reminder of the comfort and strength that comes from Allah's presence and the support of loved ones and spiritual guides. As such, the name Anis holds deep spiritual significance as a reminder of the comforting presence of Allah and the importance of meaningful relationships in our spiritual growth.
